title: REMAIN CALM Part 3: The Last Customer | Who Stays Calm?
description:
The doors are right there. So is everything else.

Mimi's smile finally cracks, and the guard who was the most afraid has to be the calm one.

🧠 Real tip: the 5-4-3-2-1 grounding trick (name 5 things you see, 4 you can touch, 3 you hear, 2 you smell, 1 you taste) can help when panic hits.
